title: Saudi-Led Coalition Reports Heavy Fighting with Houthis in Southwestern Yemen
detail: The Saudi-led coalition reported heavy fighting with Houthi forces in southwestern Yemen. Location specifics, casualties and territorial changes were not available in the feed; the claim is a coalition statement and not independently verified.

title: Sisi Says Egypt Will Defend Saudi Territory Without Attacking Yemen
detail: Egyptian President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi said Egypt would defend Saudi territory but would not attack Yemen, per a Middle East Eye live-blog update. Further details were not available in the feed.
